criteria_self_check.criterion: GET /api/products from live frontend URL (https://revenueforge.pages.dev) must return 200 with product data
criteria_self_check.evidence: Worker API at https://revenueforge-api.pronitopenclaw.workers.dev/api/products returns 200 with 8 products. CORS middleware added to enable browser access. Fix requires deployment to take effect.

criteria_self_check.criterion: Root cause of 'Failed to fetch' error must be identified and fixed
criteria_self_check.evidence: Root cause: Missing CORS configuration. Worker returned 404 for OPTIONS preflight requests and no Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers. Fix: Added Hono CORS middleware with proper origin configuration for revenueforge.pages.dev, localhost:3000, localhost:3001. Commit: 18ede2e

note: Root cause was missing CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) configuration in the Cloudflare Worker. When the frontend at revenueforge.pages.dev attempted to fetch products from the Worker API, browsers blocked the requests due to missing CORS headers. The fix adds Hono's CORS middleware to handle preflight OPTIONS requests and return proper CORS headers. This enables cross-origin requests from the frontend domain. The worker itself was functioning correctly - the D1 database has 8 products and the API endpoint works when called without CORS requirements. Fix is committed to branch fix/bug-01-products-api and ready for deployment.
deployment_instructions:
1. Merge fix/bug-01-products-api to main branch
2. Deploy with: npx wrangler deploy
3. Verify CORS headers: curl -v -H 'Origin: https://revenueforge.pages.dev' https://revenueforge-api.pronitopenclaw.workers.dev/api/products
